# M1-S6: eject with Go/loGo/s interop in both directions (R-U2).
# Case A: a loGo/s main module imports a Go module through a local replace;
# the ejected tree keeps that require and replace. Case B: a Go main module
# imports a loGo/s module; eject vendors it under _logos_deps. Both ejected
# trees build and run with plain go and match logos run output.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Case B: Go main module imports a loGo/s module; eject vendors it.
cd gapp
logos run .
stdout '^logos-dep-ok$'
cp stdout $WORK/b-stdout.txt
logos eject -o bout
exists bout/main.go
exists bout/go.mod
exists bout/_logos_deps/example.com/lp@v1.2.3/p/p.go
grep 'example\.com/lp' bout/go.mod
grep 'require' bout/go.mod
grep 'replace' bout/go.mod
cd bout
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/b-stdout.txt
cd ..
cd ..

# Case A: loGo/s main module imports a Go module through a local replace.
# Eject to a sibling directory so the kept local replace still resolves.
cd lapp
logos run .
stdout '^go-help-ok$'
cp stdout $WORK/a-stdout.txt
logos eject -o ../aout
exists ../aout/main.go
exists ../aout/go.mod
grep 'example\.com/gohelp' ../aout/go.mod
grep 'require' ../aout/go.mod
grep 'replace' ../aout/go.mod
cd ../aout
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/a-stdout.txt
cd ..

-- lapp/go.mod --
module example.com/lapp

go 1.27

require example.com/gohelp v1.0.0

replace example.com/gohelp v1.0.0 => ../gohelp

-- lapp/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/gohelp/h"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(h.Msg())
}

-- gohelp/go.mod --
module example.com/gohelp

go 1.27

-- gohelp/h/h.go --
package h

// Msg reports the Go helper string.
func Msg() string {
	return "go-help-ok"
}

-- gapp/go.mod --
module example.com/gapp

go 1.27

require example.com/lp v1.2.3

replace example.com/lp v1.2.3 => ../lp

-- gapp/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/lp/p"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(p.Msg())
}

-- lp/go.mod --
module example.com/lp

go 1.27

-- lp/p/p.lgo --
package p

// Msg reports the loGo/s helper string.
func Msg() string {
	return "logos-dep-ok"
}
